title: NemoGymMetadata
description: Sediment evidence for one NeMo Gym rollout.

instance_id.description: Stable target-row identity derived from recorded facts.

recipe_id.description: The closed evidence recipe that produced this training row.

recipe_version.description: The version of the evidence recipe; increment it when recipe semantics change.

reward_source.description: The closed source of the directional reward; absent without a verdict.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

segment_index.description: Zero-based position of this contiguous segment.

verification.description: Operator configuration for running the verifier again.

verifier_results.description: The exact recorded CI outcomes that support this row.

ci_resolution.description: The selected attempt-aware CI resolution for this row.

attribution_source.description: How the underlying attribution was established.

split.description: Which side of the deterministic eval split this row is on, hashed on `session_id` so a session never straddles both.

provenance.description: The structured provenance for this artifact.

schema_id.description: The canonical wire-shape contract for this row.

schema_version.description: The positive integer version of the canonical row schema.
The normalized fact-contract version. CI outcomes use 1.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

provider.description: The normalized CI system selected by a capture adapter or declared by the bearer-authenticated vendor integration.

run_id.description: The provider-issued pipeline-run id, unique within the deployment organization and provider namespace.

run_attempt.description: The positive provider attempt number. Null when the provider omits it.

repo.description: `owner/repo`, lowercased. Empty string when the sender omitted it.

branch.description: The branch the run or commit belongs to.

workflow_id.description: The provider's stable workflow or pipeline-definition identity.

workflow_path.description: The workflow definition's repo-relative path — the stable identity a display name does not give you. Null when unreported.

run_url.description: Link to the run in the CI system. Null when unreported; never run identity.

provider_result.description: The exact terminal value reported by the provider before normalization.

error_type.description: A structured, low-cardinality provider error type. Null when absent.

reason.description: A bounded, Basic-redacted provider reason. Null when absent.

source_event_type.description: The source contract and event type. Null when unreported.

source_spec_version.description: The source contract version. Null when unreported.

source_event_id.description: The provider or standard source event identity. Null when unreported.

pr_number.description: The pull request the run belongs to, when there is one.

captured_at.description: When Sediment stored the fact, stamped server-side. Windows and ordering anchor on this, never on a client clock.

raw.description: The source payload after Basic redaction, kept so a translator defect stays recoverable. Shape varies by provider; never join on it.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

repo.description: `owner/repo`, lowercased. Empty string when the sender omitted it.

verdict.description: The resolved pass or failure; null means no directional verdict.

reliability.description: Trust in the resolved verdict, bounded to [0, 1].

suspected_flake.description: Whether the lineage contains both passing and failing verdict attempts.

workflow_resolutions.description: Attempt-aware resolutions for the commit's workflows.

source_outcome_ids.description: Every CI outcome id that contributed to the resolution.

verdict_outcome_ids.description: The final semantic verdict outcome id from each workflow lineage.

non_verdict_outcome_ids.description: The infrastructure, timeout, cancellation, skip, neutral, or unknown evidence.

provenance.description: The structured provenance for this artifact.

provider.description: Which system this fact came from.

workflow_id.description: The provider-issued workflow definition identity, when supplied.

workflow_path.description: The workflow definition's repo-relative path — the stable identity a display name does not give you. Null when unreported.

branch.description: The branch the run or commit belongs to.

verdict.description: The resolved pass or failure; null means no directional verdict.

reliability.description: Trust in the resolved verdict, bounded to [0, 1].

suspected_flake.description: Whether the lineage contains both passing and failing verdict attempts.

source_outcome_ids.description: Every CI outcome id that contributed to the resolution.

verdict_outcome_id.description: The final semantic pass or failure outcome id.

non_verdict_outcome_ids.description: The infrastructure, timeout, cancellation, skip, neutral, or unknown evidence.

quarantine_revision.description: The integer quarantine-log high-water mark used for the derivation.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 of the fully resolved derivation policy when available.
